recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs.release/d' -i build.gradle
git clone https://github.com/rust-lang/rustup.git -b 1.25.1
export ANDROID_NDK=/opt/sdk/ndk/${PROVISIONING_NDK}
${BUILD_REPO_DIR}/rustup/rustup-init.sh -y --default-toolchain $(cat scripts/rust-toolchain) --target armv7-linux-androideabi
source $HOME/.cargo/env
scripts/ndk-make.sh armeabi-v7a
./gradlew assembleFossRelease -PABI_FILTER=armeabi-v7a
mv build/outputs/apk/foss/release/ArcaneChat-foss-unsigned-*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
